lines.text: Many learners say: Please open the light.
Better: Please turn on the light.
Turn! Please turn on the light.

native.tip: للضوء نقول turn on وليس open: “Please turn on the light.” وليس “Please open the light.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “Please open the light.” 😅 للضوء نقول turn on وليس open، فالجملة الصحيحة “Please turn on the light.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “Please open the light”?
en.tip: For a light we say turn on, not open: “Please turn on the light.” not “Please open the light.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “Please open the light.” 😅 For a light we say turn on, not open, so the right sentence is “Please turn on the light.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
